dataset: Bundled synthetic reports; isolated local run
note: Source removal is a scripted demo action, not a claim that the original analysis was incorrect.

stages.description: 1. Read the weekly briefing email preview.
2. Review the latest week: metrics, priorities, and trends.
3. Expand to all 12 weeks of synthetic reports.
4. Compare kiosks using ratings, missing reports, and unclaimed lunches per report.
5. Narrow the reporting window to one kiosk.
6. Inspect the original report fields supporting a finding.
7. Review the proposal at the human confirmation checkpoint.
8. Cancel the proposed change and inspect the recorded decision.
